originalTitle: Does Ormat Stock's Valuation Make Sense?
summary: For questions about this article or underlying research, email help@trefis.com.
content:
For questions about this article or underlying research, email help@trefis.com.

Ormat Technologies (ORA) stock trades at 44.5 times its earnings over the last twelve months, compared with 22.6 for the S&P 500. Buyers paying that price for the geothermal and energy storage company are paying today for profit it has not earned yet. So what would Ormat’s business have to deliver for that price to hold up?

To justify its current stock price without generating any additional return, Ormat would have to grow its revenue 9.4% a year for four years as its P/E settles. Trefis bases this required growth rate on three assumptions: a lower P/E, a steadier profit margin and a set number of years.

Trefis sets that lower P/E at 22.8 times earnings. It builds this figure from the 18.0 P/E it uses for utilities and Ormat’s own average P/E over the last twelve quarter-ends. While Ormat’s historical average was 40.7, Trefis caps any average above 30 at 30 for the blend. The calculation puts 60% of the weight on the utilities figure and 40% on Ormat’s.

At the October 28 close, Ormat held a market value of $5.6 billion. Under the lower P/E, that value would equal a yearly profit of $247 million. Trefis assumes a 14.5% net margin for Ormat, placing it halfway between the company’s 13.6% average and its 15.4% high over the last twelve quarter-ends. To earn that profit at that margin, Ormat would need revenue of $1.7 billion, compared with the $1.19 billion it generated over the four quarters to June 2026. Because Ormat’s P/E today is almost twice the lower one, Trefis gives the company four years to June 2030.

Is Ormat’s Business Growing Fast Enough?

On sales, Ormat is growing a little faster than required for now. Revenue climbed 10.6% from a year earlier in fiscal Q2 2026, with energy storage leading the way. Management said storage revenue rose 195.1% during the quarter. The electricity segment, Ormat’s largest business, grew 5.8% in the quarter, operating slower than the required pace.

In August, management raised its 2026 revenue guide to a range of $1.15 billion to $1.2 billion, representing about 18.7% growth at the midpoint over 2025. That $1.175 billion midpoint falls below the $1.19 billion Ormat took in over the four quarters to June 2026. With $662.7 million already booked in the first half, the guide points to about $512 million for the second half, below the $526 million of late 2025. Even if Ormat meets that guide, it would still have to grow revenue 11.2% a year from the end of 2026 to mid-2030 and keep it up for three and a half more years. That is more than the 9.4% needed today. Management also guided its own profit measure, adjusted EBITDA, to grow about 10% at the midpoint in 2026, tracking slower than its revenue guide.

Ormat Now Keeps Less Of Its Sales As Profit

Ormat’s net margin fell to 10.7% over the four quarters to June 2026, dropping from 14.5% a year earlier. That prior figure is the same level Trefis assumes in its model. At today’s net margin, Ormat would instead have to grow revenue 18.2% a year over the same four years. Management also expects energy storage’s gross margin, recorded at 56.2% in fiscal Q2 2026, to normalize to 30% to 40% in the second half of the year.

Ormat’s sales record is also uneven. Revenue grew 31.1% over the four quarters to June 2026, following a 2.2% rise over the previous four quarters. That included a 75.8% rise in fiscal Q1 2026 revenue from a year earlier. In the six twelve-month periods ending each June from 2021 to 2026, Ormat’s revenue grew faster than the required pace only twice.

For the price to hold, Ormat would have to keep growing its sales and earn the higher margin it had a year ago. If its margin stays near today’s level, Ormat would need much faster growth, and the stock becomes a riskier bet. Ormat is expected to report its next results in November 2026, and its net margin is the measure to watch.

Does This Mean You Should Act On ORA?

Our purpose is to inform you with unique data so you make the right investment decisions. That said, betting on a single stock is always risky, no matter which direction you choose.

There is a smarter approach. Since its inception, the Trefis High Quality (HQ) Portfolio has returned 105%, beating the benchmark that combines the three major indices – the S&P 500, S&P Mid-cap, and Russell 2000. chineseTitle: Ormat 股票的估值有意义吗？

chineseContent:

Ormat Technologies (ORA) 的股价在过去 12 个月中的市盈率为 44.5 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 22.6 倍。为这家地热和能源存储公司支付这个价格的买家今天正在为其尚未赚取的利润付出代价。那么，奥尔马特的业务必须提供什么才能维持这个价格呢？

为了在不产生任何额外回报的情况下证明其当前股价的合理性，Ormat 必须在市盈率稳定后的四年内将其收入每年增长 9.4%。 Trefis 将这一所需增长率建立在三个假设之上：较低的市盈率、稳定的利润率和固定的年数。

Trefis 将市盈率下调至 22.8 倍。该数字是根据公用事业公司使用的 18.0 市盈率以及 Ormat 在过去 12 个季度末的平均市盈率得出的。 Ormat 的历史平均值为 40.7，而 Trefis 将混合酒的任何高于 30 的平均值限制为 30。计算结果显示，公用事业数据占 60% 的权重，Ormat 占 40% 的权重。

截至 10 月 28 日收盘，Ormat 的市值为 56 亿美元。根据较低的市盈率，该价值相当于年利润 2.47 亿美元。 Trefis 假设 Ormat 的净利润率为 14.5%，介于该公司过去 12 个季度末平均水平 13.6% 和最高水平 15.4% 之间。为了以这样的利润率赚取这一利润，Ormat 需要 17 亿美元的收入，而截至 2026 年 6 月的四个季度的收入为 11.9 亿美元。由于 Ormat 目前的市盈率几乎是较低市盈率的两倍，Trefis 给了该公司到 2030 年 6 月的四年时间。

Ormat 的业务增长够快吗？

在销售方面，Ormat 的增长速度比目前所需的要快一些。 2026 财年第二季度收入同比增长 10.6%，其中能源存储领先。管理层表示，本季度存储收入增长了 195.1%。 Ormat 最大的业务电力部门本季度增长 5.8%，但运行速度低于要求的速度。

8 月，管理层将 2026 年收入指南上调至 11.5 亿美元至 12 亿美元，相当于 2025 年中点增长约 18.7%。这一 11.75 亿美元中点低于 Ormat 截至 2026 年 6 月的四个季度收入 11.9 亿美元。上半年已预订 6.627 亿美元，该指南指出下半年约为 5.12 亿美元，低于2025 年末将达到 5.26 亿美元。即使 Ormat 达到这一目标，从 2026 年底到 2030 年中期，它的收入仍然必须每年增长 11.2%，并在三年半的时间内保持这种增长。这超过了今天所需的 9.4%。管理层还指导其自己的利润指标（调整后的 EBITDA）在 2026 年中点增长约 10%，增速低于其收入指导。

Ormat 现在将其销售额作为利润减少

截至 2026 年 6 月的四个季度，Ormat 的净利润率从去年同期的 14.5% 降至 10.7%。先前的数字与 Trefis 在其模型中假设的水平相同。按照今天的净利润率，Ormat 在接下来的四年里必须以每年 18.2% 的速度增长收入。管理层还预计，2026财年第二季度储能的毛利率为56.2%，下半年将正常化至30%至40%。

Ormat 的销售记录也参差不齐。截至 2026 年 6 月的四个季度，收入增长 31.1%，此前四个季度增长 2.2%。其中 2026 年第一财季收入较上年同期增长 75.8%。在 2021 年至 2026 年每年 6 月结束的六个 12 个月期间，Ormat 的收入增长速度仅比要求的速度快两倍。

为了保持价格不变，Ormat 必须继续增加销售额并获得比一年前更高的利润。如果其利润率保持在今天的水平附近，Ormat 将需要更快的增长，而该股票将成为风险更大的赌注。 Ormat 预计将于 2026 年 11 月报告下一次业绩，其净利润率是值得关注的指标。

这是否意味着您应该采取 ORA 行动？

我们的目的是为您提供独特的数据，以便您做出正确的投资决策。也就是说，无论您选择哪个方向，押注单一股票总是有风险的。

有一个更聪明的方法。自成立以来，Trefis High Quality (HQ) 投资组合的回报率为 105%，超过了结合三大指数（S&P 500、S&P Mid-cap 和 Russell 2000）的基准。而且它没有承担自行选股带来的集中风险。如果这就是您想要的投资方式，那么总部投资组合就是您的起点。
